name: Example Base Charm
description: Minimal case: no prerequisites, a simple mote cost.

name: Fire and Stones Strike
description: Has a prerequisite. prerequisites is AND-of-OR: every inner list must be satisfied, and a list is satisfied by any one of its ids. Single-id lists = the common 'all required' case. For 'A and (B or C)', write [["A"], ["B", "C"]].

name: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery
description: Initiation Charm. grants_sorcery_circle is what lets a character legally learn spells of that circle; set it ONLY on the three Circle Sorcery Charms.
